reply.text: {"say":"This is a hips-and-ankles mobility session: hip openers first with the 90-90 switch, couch stretch and pigeon, then two ankle drills to finish.","title":"Hip & Ankle Mobility","days":[{"name":"Hip & Ankle Mobility","exercises":[{"key":"90-90-hip-switch","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Sit tall, rotate slowly from the hips"},{"key":"couch-stretch","sets":2,"reps":0,"repsTo":0,"seconds":45,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Squeeze the glute, keep ribs down"},{"key":"pigeon-stretch","sets":2,"reps":0,"repsTo":0,"seconds":45,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Square hips, breathe into the stretch"},{"key":"knee-to-wall-ankle-mobilization","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Heel stays down, knee tracks over toes"},{"key":"ankle-car","sets":2,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Slow, full circles each direction"}]}],"unmet":[]}
